reading.summary: This page lists Databricks machine learning certifications. The Associate exam checks basic machine learning tasks on Databricks. The Professional exam checks advanced machine learning in production tasks. Holding one shows ability to use Databricks Machine Learning.
reading.audience: The page says machine learning engineers develop, deploy, test and maintain machine learning models and pipelines using Databricks Machine Learning. The exams assess individuals who want to show those skills.
